explore.objective: Investigate a bounded question and map the relevant surface.
explore.ownershipBoundary: No target-source ownership; any written output is limited to the assigned local report artifact.
explore.permissions: Read and run non-mutating inspection commands, then return or write the assigned local findings artifact without modifying the target source.
explore.isolation: Use a fresh worker context when available.
explore.verifier: Every material claim points to resolvable evidence.
explore.stopCondition: Stop when the scoped question is answered or the evidence gap is named.
explore.returnedEvidence: Findings, source pointers, uncertainties, and checks run.

implement.objective: Produce one bounded change that satisfies explicit acceptance criteria.
implement.ownershipBoundary: One exclusive write scope and isolated output target.
implement.permissions: Write only inside the assigned scope and run its checks.
implement.isolation: Use an exclusive worktree, branch, or non-overlapping file boundary.
implement.verifier: Run the checks available to the worker and return their receipts.
implement.stopCondition: Stop when acceptance passes or a concrete blocker prevents further safe progress.
implement.returnedEvidence: Changed paths, diff summary, checks run, results, and deviations.

judge.objective: Compare or challenge artifacts against an explicit rubric.
judge.ownershipBoundary: Do not modify candidates or target source; any written output is limited to the assigned local evaluation artifact.
judge.permissions: Read evidence, run non-mutating checks needed to score the rubric, then return or write the assigned local scorecard or review artifact.
judge.isolation: Use a fresh context and blind candidate identity when practical.
judge.verifier: Every score or finding cites the rubric and supporting evidence.
judge.stopCondition: Stop after every candidate or claim in scope has a reasoned disposition.
judge.returnedEvidence: Scores, findings, evidence, uncertainties, and recommendation.

explain.objective: Translate grounded evidence for the intended audience.
explain.ownershipBoundary: Do not change the source being explained; any written output is limited to the assigned local explanation artifact.
explain.permissions: Read the supplied evidence and relevant source pointers, then return or write the assigned local explanation artifact.
explain.isolation: Use a separate synthesis context when the input is large or contested.
explain.verifier: The explanation is traceable to source evidence and fits the requested audience.
explain.stopCondition: Stop when the question is answered without unsupported claims or unnecessary detail.
explain.returnedEvidence: Explanation plus the source pointers needed to verify it.

verify.objective: Independently exercise acceptance criteria on the required surface.
verify.ownershipBoundary: Do not modify the implementation under test; any written output is limited to the assigned local verification artifact.
verify.permissions: Read the implementation, operate only the tools or surfaces needed for proof, then return or write the assigned local receipts or verification artifact.
verify.isolation: Use a fresh context that did not author the implementation when available.
verify.verifier: Reproduce the acceptance workflow and return pass, fail, or blocked with receipts.
verify.stopCondition: Stop when every criterion has a verdict or an exact capability gap is proven.
verify.returnedEvidence: Verdict, commands or interaction steps, outputs or artifacts, and uncovered gaps.
